Erudite
solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Erudite"** means having or showing great knowledge or learning. (विद्वान)

 
 
• **Example: **His **erudite** commentary on classical literature impressed everyone at the seminar.
 
 
 
• **"Educated" **refers to someone who has received a good amount of schooling or training, and is knowledgeable. (शिक्षित)
 
 
• **Example: **She is highly **educated**, having completed her PhD from a prestigious university.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Erudite'** is **'Educated'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Strong** (मजबूत): Having great physical power or being mentally resilient.

 
 
• **Example:** She has a strong will and always stands up for what she believes in.
 
 
 
• **Humble** (विनम्र): Having or showing a modest or low estimate of one's importance.
 
 
• **Example:** Despite his achievements, he remains a humble person.
 
 
 
• **Honest** (ईमानदार): Being truthful and sincere.
 
 
• **Example:** He is known for being an honest and trustworthy individual.
